295:t_003:1.en:
$$尸刻$$
「You have arrived early. What of this business with the $$メガノイド$$s?」

295:t_003:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「It's been dealt with. ...To be precise, I should say it had already been dealt with.」

295:t_003:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hey, $$尸空#pilot$$... It's been ages since we last met, so saying hello to us wouldn't kill you.」

295:t_003:5.en:
$$メール$$
「Totally ignoring the $$ガンレオン$$! Gun-ignoring, for short!」

295:t_003:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「The point is, this guy and us just don't mesh, right down to the root!」

295:t_003:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「No point wasting words on this guy! I'll beat him down with sheer strength!」

295:t_003:10.en:
$n
「Being praised by you doesn't make me happy at all!」

295:t_003:11.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I did not say it to praise you...」

295:t_003:12.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Come, $$いがみ合う双子$$. I'll take you on for three minutes today.」

295:t_004:5.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$... I will dispose of you here.」

295:t_006:0.en:
$n
「He covered that distance in an instant...!」

295:t_006:1.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Once you enter the Third Stage, you can pull off feats like this.」

295:t_006:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「What a shame, $F. I thought you could climb this high, but the situation did not allow it.」

295:t_006:3.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I cannot let him have your $$スフィア$$.」

295:t_006:5.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「If you dislike pain, do not resist.」

295:t_008:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Are you really $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...!?」

295:t_008:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「What the heck, you! So you were playing dead!」

295:t_008:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Let's save that talk for later, $$セツコ$$, $$ランド$$. Here is where we defeat the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$.」

295:t_008:7.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I chased him all the way to Mars, and this turns out to be an unexpected find.」

295:t_008:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then, though it's a hackneyed line to say to you, I'll call him here too, as a parting gift for the grave.」

295:t_009:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「There is no need to worry. His target right now is the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$.」

295:t_009:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...If you want to laugh, go ahead and laugh.」

295:t_009:7.en:
$$シン$$
「So $$アサキム$$ has teamed up with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

295:t_009:8.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Could it be that the one who freed him from $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ was...」

295:t_009:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「So it was $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

295:t_009:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Come, $n... Let us fight together once more.」

295:t_009:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You cannot bring yourself to trust me. ...But that is understandable.」

295:t_011:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「For the world, for the people, $$ダイターン３$$ shatters the schemes of evil!」

295:t_011:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「If you're not afraid of the radiance of this sun, come and get it!」

295:t_012:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「I told you, $$尸空#pilot$$. Now that I've defeated the $$メガノイド$$s, I'll pour everything I have into the fight against the $$サイデリアル$$.」

295:t_012:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「What the heck! So it was Big Bro $$万丈$$ who took down those $$メガノイド$$s!」

295:t_012:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「Sorry, $$勝平$$. While I was taking care of a trifling errand, I left all the hardship to you and the others.」

295:t_012:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「Forget it! Looks like that errand's finished now anyway!」

295:t_012:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You'll fight alongside us again, right, $$万丈$$!」

295:t_012:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「I'll make up for the lost time with overtime, President.」

295:t_012:8.en:
$n
「So that's... the dashing fellow, $$破嵐万丈$$.」

295:t_012:9.en:
$$ガロード$$
「He's just what he looks like. Just having him around brightens the whole place up.」

295:t_012:10.en:
$$ロラン$$
「He's truly a man who carries the sun on his back.」

295:t_013:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「Sorry to ask when we've only just met, but could you back me up?」

295:t_013:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「I don't know the circumstances, but a shock big enough to leave you standing frozen on a battlefield doesn't go away that easily.」

295:t_014:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$沈黙の巨蟹$$, $$尸空#pilot$$... Shall we start over?」

295:t_015:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Very well. The cast is all here.」

295:t_016:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$c. $$アサキム$$ and I will cover you.」

295:t_016:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Can we trust you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$?」

295:t_016:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「You, maybe. But that $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ over there can't be trusted.」
